new_results.statement: For a critical two-original-hub packet with slope S=BY+d, K=||p_S||inf, and a source-disjoint bank W whose residual law conditional on Y=y has uniformly bounded L^r density norm M_r for 1<r<=2, the full packet has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||inf <= C_cond(r) K^(1/(r+1)) M_r^(r/(r+1)). The proof integrates the conditional Hausdorff-Young budget into the actual complex slope pushforward before the two-hub Plancherel step.

For Q=H^TCH+2H^T(BY+d)+R(Y)+2cUV+alpha(Y)U+gamma(Y)V+delta(Y), with source split H|Y|U|V, rank(B)=2 and c!=0, arbitrary Y-dependent affine entanglement of the hyperbolic edge is allowed. The density is continuous and ||p_Q||inf <= C_ent(r) det(BB^T)^(-1/[2(r+1)]) |c|^(-(r-1)/(r+1)); at r=2 the exact constant is 3 and the bound is 3 det(BB^T)^(-1/6)|c|^(-1/3).

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: For each fixed y, completing 2cUV+alpha(y)U+gamma(y)V+delta(y) as a translated product lets the partner estimate ||q_y||_r <= 2^((r-1)/r)|c|^(-(r-1)/r) feed the new conditional-L^r theorem.
